plan.text: Win DA, retaining DK. Cash CA and CK, then lead a club to CQ. On a 3–2 split, return to South via SA and cash the remaining clubs for ten tricks with HA, HK and DK. On a 4–1 split, return via SA and concede a club to establish the fourth club winner; DK protects against diamonds, giving nine tricks with both heart tops. Reassess if clubs are 5–0.

advice.publicReason: Play low and win in South, preserving the second diamond stopper while developing clubs.
